newsitem.title: THAILAND: New Year revellers die in Thai road accident.
newsitem.headline: New Year revellers die in Thai road accident.

text.p: Fourteen people died and two were injured when a bus carrying New Year revellers collided head-on with a truck in northern Thailand, police said on Thursday.
Police said the bus carrying 16 people was heading towards a lakeside resort in Chiang Mai, 740 km (450 miles) north of Bangkok, when it collided with the fruit truck late on Wednesday.
Police said 12 people, including the bus driver, were killed at the scene and two were pronounced dead on arrival at a nearby hospital. All the dead and injured were from the bus.
The truck driver escaped with only minor injuries and is being detained by police.
